matter_background.original: Kusum Jayawardana wishes to lease out the upstair of her house bearing assessment No. 30/1 situated at Nawala Road, Rajagiriya to Ravi Perera at a monthly rental of Rs. 75,000/- for a period of 2 years. She requests for a refundable deposit of Rs. 200,000/- and 1 year rent to be paid in advance to be set off against the rent payable in the 2nd Year at the execution of the Lease Agreement. Further she says that the lessee should bear the cost of repairs upto a sum of Rs. 10,000/- at any one time and that he should not do any structural repairs to the premises. Also without her consent he cannot assign, sublet or part with the possession of the demised premises. The Lessee should pay the water, electricity and telephone bills and that at the end of the term should hand over vacant possession in the same good order.
